```python
import asyncio
from fastmcp import FastMCP
from fastmcp.prompts import PromptResult, Message


mcp = FastMCP("summarize-server", instructions="Server providing a summarize prompt template")


@mcp.prompt
def summarize(text: str) -> PromptResult:
    """Generate a summarization prompt for the given text."""
    return PromptResult(
        Message(f"Please summarize the following text:\n\n{text}", role="user")
    )


async def main():
    async with mcp.run_stdio_async():
        await asyncio.Event().wait()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())
```
